app.subtitle: NMS Save Editor
status.game_running: The game is open: close it before applying changes.
status.game_unknown: Couldn't check whether the game is open
status.no_folder: Couldn't find your save folder. Set it in Settings.
common.name: Name
slots.title: Your saves
slots.help: Each slot has two files (autosave and manual save). Olympian applies changes to both, so it doesn't matter which one the game loads.
travel.title: Galaxy travel
travel.help: Pick a destination and how you want to appear. Olympian changes your current location, your previous location and how you spawn, together.
travel.system_hint: A low number (1, 2, 3…) almost always exists in any region.
travel.spawn_ship: Inside my ship, floating in space (recommended)
ships.title: Ships
ships.help: Drag ships to change their order. Press “Options” on a ship to see its details and what you can do with it.
settings.title: Settings
settings.term_note: Content = item, technology and ship type names, read from your game files. Names you chose and galaxies are not translated.
settings.lz4_missing: Note: the compression library is missing. Olympian still works, but files will be larger.
preview.title: Here's what will happen
preview.blocked: Can't apply while there is a red warning.
result.title: Done
result.verified: Verified: the file reads back exactly as the game would read it.
result.cloud: If you use Steam Cloud: open the game on this computer so Steam uploads the new version before you play elsewhere.
msg.game_running: No Man's Sky is open. Close it completely: if it stays open, it will overwrite the changes when it saves or exits.
msg.game_unknown: Couldn't check whether the game is open. Make sure it is closed before applying.
msg.files_differ: The two files of this slot are not identical (e.g. one has different ships). Olympian applies the change to each one separately.
msg.ship_empty: In {file}, slot {n} is empty: it can't be the primary ship.
msg.primary_change: {file}: primary ship goes from slot {old} ({old_name}) to {new} ({new_name}).
msg.primary_safe: Changing the primary ship doesn't affect your inventory, ships or missions.
msg.address_invalid: The destination has out-of-range values ({fields}). Check the coordinates.
msg.spawn_keep_risky: You're moving but keeping how you spawn ({state}). If you were inside a station or on foot, the game would put you at that same position in the new system: you could appear floating on foot in space or inside something. We recommend «Inside my ship».
msg.travel_prev_too: Your «previous location» is updated too. Otherwise, warping could send you back to the old galaxy.
msg.spawn_ship: You'll appear inside your ship, about 20 km above your current position in the system. Planets are usually more than 100 km away, so you shouldn't hit anything.
msg.galaxy_256: Odyalutai (galaxy 256) can't be reached in normal play since 2017. Reaching it by editing isn't guaranteed by the community. Try with a restore point first.
msg.system_may_not_exist: We can't confirm that system {sys} exists in that region of that galaxy. If something looks odd on load, restore and try another low number.
msg.planet_nonzero: You chose a planet other than 0. To appear in space it's normally 0; the position isn't adjusted to the planet surface.
msg.bases_stay: Your bases and corvettes stay where they are. You can reach them with the teleporter; you can summon the freighter in the new system.
msg.same_slot: You can't copy a save onto its own slot.
msg.dest_not_empty: Slot {slot} already has a save. It will be replaced (an automatic backup is saved first).
msg.copy_what: {src} is copied to both files of slot {slot}, named «{name}».
msg.copy_reencrypt: Each copy is re-encrypted with its new slot's key. That's why copying and renaming the files by hand doesn't work.
msg.rename_what: Slot {slot} will be called «{name}» in the load menu.
msg.restore_backup_first: Before restoring, a backup of the current files is saved in case you change your mind.
err.game_running: The game is open. Close it and try again.
err.changed_on_disk: The save changed since the preview (did the game save?). Generate the preview again.
err.plan_expired: The preview expired. Generate it again.
err.folder_invalid: That folder doesn't contain No Man's Sky saves.
err.point_invalid: That restore point is not valid.
err.point_missing: That restore point no longer exists (was it deleted from the folder?).
err.verify_failed: Verification failed before writing; your save was not touched.
start.title: Which save do you want to edit?
start.help: Pick a save to open the editor. Nothing is written to your files until you press “Save”.
start.backup_help: An exact copy of slot {slot} (“{name}”) is stored in the _OlympianRestorePoints folder. It will show up in the backups table.
start.backups_help: Yours and the automatic ones (made before every save). You can restore any of them into any slot.
start.restore_help: You are restoring “{name}” (backup from {date}). Choose the slot to put it in; the next step shows what gets replaced.
editor.discard_q: These changes will be lost (your files have not been touched):
editor.unsaved_switch: Before going to {dest}, decide what to do with these changes:
editor.staged_toast: Change ready. Press Save (top right) to write it to your files.
summary.title: Save summary
summary.help: Changes you make in Travel and Ships collect here and are written together when you press Save.
ships.icons_note: Icons are the game's official emblems for each ship type. Drawing your exact ship (shape and colours from its seed) needs the game's 3D engine.
preview.staged_note: This doesn't touch your files yet: it is added to the pending changes and written when you press “Save”.
msg.reorder_corvettes: {n} corvette references (its base and its editor) were updated so they still point to the right ship.
msg.reorder_safe: Only the order changes. Your ships, inventories and technologies are not modified; the primary ship stays the same.
msg.order_invalid: The received order is not valid. Reload the screen and try again.
msg.point_empty: That backup contains no save files.
msg.restore_overwrites: Slot {slot} already has a save (“{name}”). It will be replaced by the backup.
msg.restore_to_what: “{name}” (backup of slot {from_slot}) is restored into both files of slot {slot}.
msg.dest_open_unsaved: Slot {slot} is open in the editor with unsaved changes. Save or discard them first.
msg.save_backup: Before writing, an automatic backup of your current files is made.
err.session_dirty: You have unsaved changes. Save or discard them first.
err.blocked: Can't apply while there is a red warning.
err.reorder_verify: The new order failed verification; nothing was changed.
editor.exit_q: What should we do with these changes before exiting?
editor.closed: Done. You can close this window now.
ship.protect_corvette: Corvette: it is linked to its build base. Rename, repair, recharge, opening cells, expanding it to the S-class maximum like any ship and auto-sorting its technology are allowed; deleting it too, as in the game.
ship.protect_living: Protected living ship: its inventory is organic. It isn't expanded, doesn't change class and doesn't receive modules from other ships.
ship.expand_needs_s: S class only (120). To reach S, upgrade it in-game.
ship.copy_none: No other regular ship to copy from.
msg.ship_protected: Ship {n} ({name}) is protected for this action.
msg.ship_files_differ: In {file}, ship {n} ({name}) doesn't match the other file of the slot. Save in-game to sync them and try again.
msg.ship_repair_what: {file}: ship {n} ({name}) — {fixed} modules or damaged cells repaired, as the game repairs them: modules undamaged and fully installed; in damaged cells the damaged component goes away and the cell is left free.
msg.ship_nothing: This ship was already in perfect shape; nothing to change.
msg.ship_expand_class: Ship {n} ({name}) is class {cls}. Only S class reaches 120 / 60; change the class first.
msg.ship_grid_bigger: Ship {n} ({name})'s grid is already larger than the maximum; left untouched.
msg.ship_seed_invalid: The seed must be 0x followed by up to 16 hexadecimal characters (0-9, A-F).
msg.ship_seed_look: The seed changes the ship's look (shape and colours); model and type stay. There's no preview: if you don't like it, discard or restore.
msg.ship_no_free: No free ship slots (12 max). Delete one first.
msg.ship_duplicate_what: {file}: exact copy of ship {n} ({name}) in slot {slot}, with its inventory and technology.
msg.ship_in_use_primary: Ship {n} ({name}) is your primary ship. Make another one primary before deleting it.
msg.ship_in_use_corvette_edit: Ship {n} ({name}) is open in the game's corvette editor; it can't be deleted.
msg.ship_in_use_corvette_base: Ship {n} ({name}) is linked to a corvette base; it can't be deleted.
msg.ship_last: You can't be left without ships.
msg.ship_old_format: This save uses an old format; deleting is not available.
msg.ship_delete_what: {file}: ship {n} ({name}) disappears with all its inventory and technology. Its slot becomes free.
msg.ship_delete_others: The other ships don't move, so your corvettes and their base still point to the right place.
msg.ship_copy_src: Choose another ship to copy from.
msg.ship_copy_src_kind: Modules are only copied from regular ships (not corvettes or living ships).
msg.ship_copy_grid: Ship {n} ({name}) lacks cells at the positions the other ship uses ({need} modules, {have} cells unlocked). Expand it first.
msg.ship_copy_full: Ship {n} ({name})'s own modules don't fit next to the copied ones. Expand it first.
msg.ship_copy_what: {file}: ship {n} ({name}) gets the {n_items} modules of “{src}” in the same positions; keeps {kept} of its own and replaces {replaced} duplicates.
msg.ship_copy_super: Supercharged cells belong to each ship: a copied module may end up outside them and perform a bit lower.
err.ship_verify: The ship change failed verification; nothing was done.
err.ship_verify_outside: Verification found a change outside the ship; nothing was done.
err.ship_overlap: Internal error preparing the change; nothing was done.
slots.name_lost: The game will erase the name “{name}” the next time it saves (an earlier Olympian version wrote it in the wrong place). Rename it again in Summary → Rename to fix it.
start.changes_undo: Restoring this backup undoes these changes.
start.changes_unknown: No change details (backup from an earlier version).
ship.class_note: Changing the class isn't available: an in-game upgrade also recalculates stats and adds supercharged slots using an internal game formula that isn't public; from the save we could only change the letter. Upgrade it at a starship outfitter with nanites.
ship.expand_note: cargo only. Technology is expanded once the ship already has its 4 supercharged cells (the game places them).
log.title: History (last 10 changes)
log.empty: No changes saved in this save yet.
log.help: “Go back to before” returns the whole save to how it was before that save. It goes to pending changes; nothing is written until you press Save.
log.revert: Go back to before this change
log.same_session: Saved together with {n} more change(s): all of them go back.
msg.chg_revert: Return the save to how it was on {when}
action.revert: before going back to an earlier state
msg.revert_other_slot: That backup belongs to another save.
msg.revert_what: The whole save goes back to before that save. {n} Olympian changes are undone and about {hours} h of later play are lost.
msg.revert_also_game: What you did playing after that moment is lost too: items, units, nanites, ships bought or sold, buildings and mission progress.
msg.revert_not_account: Account-wide things don't go back: claimed expedition rewards, account unlocks, Steam achievements, uploaded discoveries and anything you gave to other players.
msg.revert_no_dupes: Please don't use it to duplicate items with other players in multiplayer.
msg.chg_ship_restore_original: Ship {n} ({name}): returned to its original state
action.ship_restore_original: before returning a ship to its original state
msg.revert_what_lt1: The whole save goes back to before that save. {n} Olympian changes are undone and later play is lost (less than 1 h).
gd.title: Game data
gd.ok: Up to date with your game
gd.old_help: The game was updated after the data was generated: some names might be missing or outdated. Look for a new Olympian release, or rebuild them with tools/build_gamedata.py (see the README).
gd.none: No game data: items are shown with their internal code.
grid.drag_hint: Drag an item to another cell to move it; if the cell is taken they swap. Each move goes to pending changes.
action.ship_move: before moving a ship to another save
inv.title: Inventories
inv.help: Drag items within an inventory or from one to another: onto the same item they merge up to the stack limit, onto a different item they swap. Click an item to select it (Esc clears the selection); drag one of several selected items and they all move together to another inventory. Right-click to split, fill, duplicate or delete. Everything goes to pending changes and is written on Save.
inv.level: Stack limits of your save: level “{level}” (difficulty setting). They apply when items go from one inventory to another.
inv.no_level: This save does not state its stack-limit level: items can only be moved within the same inventory or to another of the same type.
inv.found_more: … and {n} more items. Type more letters to narrow it down.
msg.inv_move_part: {item}: {n} went to {dst} (its stack limit is {mx}); {left} stay in {src}.
msg.inv_merge_part: {item}: {n} merged into the stack in {dst} (limit {mx}); {left} stay in {src}.
msg.inv_stack_full: The {item} stack in {dst} is already full ({mx}).
msg.inv_tech_cross: Technology is installed in its inventory and is not moved to another one.
msg.inv_limit_unknown: The stack limit of {item} in {dst} cannot be worked out; to be safe it is not moved to another inventory.
msg.inv_swap_over: They do not fit when swapping: {item} allows {mx} in {dst} and {other} allows {mx2} in {src}.
msg.inv_files_differ: The two files of this save ({file}) hold that inventory differently and the manual save cannot be told apart.
inv.sort_hint: Merges equal stacks and sorts by name, rarity or value. Installed technology is not moved.
inv.sort.name: alphabetical
inv.sort_help.name.asc: A to Z, using the names in the content language.
inv.sort_help.name.desc: Z to A, using the names in the content language.
inv.sort_help.rarity.asc: Common to rare. Modules go by class: C, B, A, S, then X and special.
inv.sort_help.rarity.desc: Rare to common. Modules go by class: X and special, S, A, B and C.
inv.sort_help.value.asc: Lowest to highest unit value (the game's base price). Modules have no base price.
inv.sort_help.value.desc: Highest to lowest unit value (the game's base price). Modules have no base price.
inv.gather_hint: Brings every item of one type from other inventories into this one.
inv.scope.all: everything, including the exosuit and ships
inv.gather_note: Tick only the ones you want to bring (for example, the most valuable minerals). Stacks already here are topped up first, then free cells are used; whatever does not fit stays where it was.
msg.inv_gather_what: {inv}: {units} units of {group} arrive ({n} stacks emptied at their source).
msg.inv_gather_left: {n} stacks did not fit completely in {inv}: the rest stays in its inventory.
msg.inv_gather_unknown: {n} items were left where they were because their stack limit cannot be worked out.
msg.inv_gather_none: There are no {group} in the chosen inventories.
msg.inv_gather_full: There is no room in {inv} for {group}.
msg.inv_rename_default: {inv} goes back to its default name.
msg.inv_rename_same: The container already has that name.
inv.grp.mods_sx: class S, X and special modules
start.no_history: No changes saved with Olympian yet.
inv.pick_count: {n} of {of} items ticked. Sorted from most to least valuable.
inv.movesel_hint: Select items with a click and take them all together to another inventory.
inv.movesel_note: Equal stacks in the destination are topped up first, then its free cells are used, with that inventory's stack limit. Whatever does not fit stays where it was. Installed technology is not moved.
inv.op.tech_note: Installed technology: it cannot be changed from here.
inv.split_n: Amount for the new stack (there are {a})
inv.split_help: The new stack will hold {n} and {left} will stay in the original. The new one takes the first free cell.
msg.inv_many_what: {n} whole stacks from {src} to {dst} ({units} units in total).
msg.inv_item_tech: It is installed technology: it cannot be changed from here.
msg.inv_split_bad: To split {item} give an amount between 1 and {mx}.
msg.inv_no_room: There are no free cells in {inv} for {item}.
msg.inv_split_what: {item}: new stack of {n} at {to}; {left} stay at {at}.
msg.inv_fill_what: {item} in {inv} {at}: {n} units are added up to the max ({mx}). This creates items.
msg.inv_dup_what: {item}: copy of the stack ({n}) in {inv} {to}. This creates items.
msg.inv_delete_what: {item}: {n} units are deleted from {inv} {at}. They cannot be recovered except by discarding or restoring a backup.
inv.add_rules_cargo: This inventory takes substances and products. Technology is only installed in each ship's technology grid.
inv.add_rules_tech: Only what the game allows on this ship is listed: its technology and modules of its kind (regular, or “UA” on living ships), without repeating a technology already installed or another one with the same role, and up to 3 modules of each kind. Rechargeable technology is installed fully charged.
inv.add_note: This creates items in your save. It goes to pending changes; if you change your mind, “Discard changes” before Saving.
inv.add_none: Nothing the game allows can be added here (for example, corvette technology is built with corvette parts).
inv.add_count_more: {n} items; {shown} shown. Type to narrow it down.
msg.inv_add_unknown: {item} is not in the game data.
msg.inv_add_not_cargo: {item} is technology: it does not go in {inv}, it is installed in a ship's technology grid.
msg.inv_add_corvette: Corvette technology is built with corvette parts; it is not added from here.
msg.inv_add_wrong_ship: {item} is not for this kind of ship.
msg.inv_add_not_tech: {item} is not technology: it does not go in the technology grid.
msg.inv_add_dup_tech: {item} is already installed on this ship.
msg.inv_add_same_role: This ship already has {other}, which does the same job as {item}.
msg.inv_add_mods_full: This ship already has {n} modules of that kind (the game's maximum).
msg.inv_add_no_template: No item was found in the save to copy its format from.
jv.title: JSON viewer
jv.help: The whole save with readable names (what you see includes your pending changes). Read-only: to change something use the other sections, which check every change. Click a row to see its details, notes and dependencies.
jv.search: Search field, value or item name…
jv.pick: Pick a row in the tree to see its details.
jv.copy_fail: Could not copy to the clipboard.
jv.found: {n} matches. Click to go to each one.
jv.found_more: The first {n} matches are shown; type something more specific.
jv.n.jv_address: The player's current location (galaxy, system, planet). Changing it by hand can leave you inside terrain or in an ungenerated system: use the Travel section.
jv.n.jv_prev_address: Previous location; the game uses it to go back.
jv.n.jv_savename: Save name shown in the load menu. Change it from Summary.
jv.n.jv_savename_psd: Old copy of the name that the game does not read. Olympian removes it when renaming.
jv.n.jv_ships: List of ships. The order matters: the primary ship (PrimaryShip), the corvette's associated ship (CorvetteEditAssociatedShipIndex) and the corvette base (UserData) point by position. To reorder use Ships, which fixes those references.
jv.n.jv_ship: One ship. Its look comes from Resource (file and seed); its class, stats and supercharged cells are in its inventories.
jv.n.jv_primary: Position of the ship you are using. It must point to an existing ship.
jv.n.jv_corvette_idx: Position of the ship this corvette is linked to. It must be updated if the ship order changes.
jv.n.jv_seed: Seed: defines the procedural look. Changing it changes the model, not the class or the supercharged cells.
jv.n.jv_stats: Base stats. The game recalculates them with its own formula; hand edits do not last.
jv.n.jv_slots: Inventory items. Each one must sit on an unlocked cell (ValidSlotIndices), one per cell, and its MaxAmount follows the inventory's stack limit.
jv.n.jv_valid: Unlocked cells of the inventory. Removing cells with items on them loses those items.
jv.n.jv_stackgroup: Inventory type for the stack limit (Personal, Ship, Freighter, Chest…).
jv.n.jv_maxamount: This item's stack limit here: difficulty level × inventory type × item multiplier.
jv.n.jv_currency: Currency. Big changes may affect achievements or online play; do not use them in multiplayer.
jv.n.jv_bases: Player bases (including each corvette's internal base). Heavily linked to the universe: editing them by hand is not recommended.
jv.n.jv_base_userdata: In a corvette base, the position of its ship in the ship list.
jv.n.jv_difficulty: Difficulty settings of the save (including the stack-limit level).
jv.n.jv_freighter_address: Freighter location. It must match a valid system.
jv.n.jv_season: Expedition data. Editing it can break the expedition.
jv.n.jv_version: Save version/platform. Do not change it: the game uses it to read the file.
jv.n.jv_ref_corvette: Ship {n} uses it as the corvette's associated ship.
jv.n.jv_ref_base: Base {n} (a corvette's internal base) points to this ship.
mis.title: Missions
mis.help: Every mission your save keeps, with its in-game name and state. “Not started (-1)” is a mission never started or reset; “Saved stage N” is the point of its stage tree where the save left it: the game does not move it to the last stage when it ends, so it does not tell how much is left; “Game mark” is a special value the game puts on finished, procedural and repeatable missions. Different missions that share a title (for example the parts of a chapter) are shown together. Click to select and use the buttons.
mis.mark_tip: Value 2147483647: a mark the game puts on procedural/repeatable missions. Its exact meaning is not documented.
mis.crit_tip: The game marks it as critical (story or important progress).
mis.more: … and {n} more. Use the search or the filters.
mis.reset_explain: The mission goes back to “not started” (-1), which is what the community does to replay or unstick it. Rewards you already got are not taken away. If it is the active mission, Olympian leaves a neutral mission active (for example, “Atlas eterno”) so the game restarts it properly, and reminds you to select it after loading.
mis.reset_chain: Also reset the next steps of the same series
mis.reset_chain_help: For example, ACT2_STEP8 includes ACT2_STEP9, 10, 11… Step-by-step stories usually need it to show up again.
mis.stage_warn: Experimental. Each stage, when completed in the game, also writes other data (items, markers, other missions). This only changes the stage number: the mission can be left half done or not advance. Use it to unstick a mission the game left stuck, not to skip content.
msg.mis_files_differ: The files of the slot hold different mission lists ({file}).
msg.mis_not_in_file: {n} of the chosen missions are not in {file}; they are skipped there.
msg.mis_delete_current: {id} is the active mission in {file}: the game is using it right now. Switch missions in the game, save and try again.
msg.mis_stage_one: Change stage works with a single mission.
msg.mis_stage_range: The stage must be between 0 and {n}.
msg.mis_reset_note: After loading, the game may take a moment to show it in the mission log.
msg.mis_reset_current: It includes the active mission ({file}): in the game, switch to another mission and back so it resets properly.
msg.mis_delete_what: {n} entries are deleted: {names}. The game may create them again if their conditions are met.
msg.mis_delete_story: It includes critical story missions: deleting them can stop the story from advancing. To replay them, “Reset” is better.
msg.mis_stage_risk: Experimental: the data that stage would write in the game is not created.
msg.mis_switched: So the game engine restarts “{reset}” ({reset_id}) properly, Olympian left a neutral mission active, “{neutral}” ({neutral_id}), in {file}: the game does not restart the mission it has selected. After loading the save, open the mission log and select “{reset}” yourself.
msg.mis_no_neutral: {id} is the active mission in {file} and there is no other running mission to leave active while it is reset. Select another mission in the game, save and try again.
msg.chg_mis_reset_switch: Missions: {n} reset ({names}); active: “{neutral}”. In the game, select “{reset}”
mis.side_pick: Click a mission to see what to do now and what comes next.
mis.side_none: The game has no objective texts for this stage of the mission.
mis.side_done: It is at the end of its stage tree: there is no next step.
mis.side_mark: Procedural mission with the game's special mark: its objectives are generated when you play it.
mis.side_note: Summary taken from the game's own objective texts for this stage. It is a guide: some missions branch and the game may show another step depending on your choices.
set.title: Settlements
set.help: Your settlements as the game saved them, with an advisor based on the game's own data. Here you can rename them, remove perks they already have and dismiss the pending decision. As agreed, Olympian does not edit stats or finish constructions or upgrades.
set.no_data: This version's game data has no settlement data. Rebuild the game data.
set.no_owner: I could not find your player ID in this save, so I cannot tell which settlements are yours.
set.none: This save has no settlements of yours. Other players' settlements you visited are neither shown nor touched.
set.stats_note: "Good", "fair" and "poor" use the thresholds the game itself defines for each stat (Olympian's reading); for maintenance, alerts and threats, less is better. Any debt counts as "poor": the game stops production while there is debt.
set.pending_help: Resolving it in the game (at your office) is what gives its rewards and changes. Dismissing it here only removes it; the game brings the next one after its usual wait.
set.building: Under construction or upgrade: {name}. It finishes in the game; Olympian does not speed up construction.
set.prod_note: Collect it in the game by talking to the overseer. The save keeps no accumulated amount (the game works it out from its own timers), so Olympian does not collect it rather than make amounts up.
set.perks_help: Tick the perks you want to remove. Olympian never adds perks.
set.population: Population: {n} (the game allows up to {max} NPCs)
set.routes_help: Known missions that start at a settlement, with your progress in each (from your mission list).
set.route.end: at the end of its tree
set.reward.drone_mech: Reward: the Sentinel drone companion and the Minotaur's Hardframe upgrades
set.routes_note: Rewards come from community guides; progress and steps from your save and the game's mission tables. To reset or adjust a mission use the Missions section.
adv.debt: Debt of {debt} u. The game says: "{game}". The game's tip: {tip}.
adv.debt_compare: Productivity {prod} and maintenance cost {cost}: productivity is higher.
adv.debt_compare_bad: Productivity {prod} and maintenance cost {cost}: maintenance is equal or higher.
adv.stat_bad: {stat}: poor level ({v} of a maximum of {max}).
adv.neg_perks: It has {n} negative perks: {names}. Removing them changes the settlement's balance.
adv.pending: Pending decision: "{title}". Resolve it at your office to get its effects.
adv.building: A construction or upgrade is in progress: {name}.
adv.perks_full: It has {n} perks; the game's maximum is {max}.
adv.all_good: Nothing urgent according to the game's data.
msg.set_not_found: I could not find that settlement among yours.
msg.set_name_invalid: Type a name of 1 to {max} characters.
msg.set_perk_pick: The perk selection no longer matches the save. Open Settlements again.
msg.set_no_decision: That settlement has no pending decision.
msg.set_not_in_file: {file} does not have this settlement; that file stays as it is.
msg.set_files_differ: The perks in {file} do not match the other file; nothing is changed.
msg.set_perk_remove_positive: Some of them are positive: the settlement loses their benefits.
msg.set_perk_remove_note: The game recalculates the stats with the remaining perks; Olympian does not touch the stats.
msg.set_skip_what: "{title}" at "{name}" is dismissed without applying any option or reward.
msg.set_skip_note: The game brings the next decision after its usual wait (between {lo} and {hi} minutes).
inv.tech_hint: Drag to move within the grid. Right-click an empty cell to install; right-click a technology to uninstall it.
inv.group_tech_help: Exosuit, freighter and multi-tools. Ship technology is under Ships.
inv.op.uninstall_note: Core technology (life support, hazard protection, jetpack…) cannot be removed, as in the game.
inv.add_rules_grid.suittech: Only exosuit technology and its upgrade modules, one of each and up to 3 modules of a kind.
inv.add_rules_grid.freightertech: Only freighter technology and its upgrade modules, one of each and up to 3 modules of a kind.
inv.add_rules_grid.mttech: Only multi-tool technology and its upgrade modules, one of each and up to 3 modules of a kind.
msg.inv_mt_unclear: I cannot tell which copy of the multi-tool in hand the game reads, so its grids are not edited.
msg.inv_delete_core: {item} is core technology; the game does not allow removing it.
jv.expert_warn: It lets you change save values by hand. Use it only if you know what the value means: a wrong change can break missions, bases or the inventory.
jv.expert_rule1: Only text, numbers and yes/no; never objects or lists, nor adding or removing fields.
jv.expert_rule2: The new value must be of the same type as the current one.
jv.expert_rule3: Only the file you are viewing changes.
jv.expert_rule4: Like any change, it stays pending and is verified; nothing is written until you press Save (with a backup).
jv.ed_not_here: This node cannot be edited in expert mode (objects, lists, empty values and binary IDs).
jv.n.jv_settlements: Settlements: yours and those of other players you visited. The Settlements section shows only yours.
jv.n.jv_settlement_stats: Settlement stats. Editing them by hand breaks the game's balance (which is why the Settlements section does not).
msg.json_bad_path: That value no longer exists in the save. Select it again.
msg.json_not_scalar: Only text, numbers and yes/no can be changed.
msg.json_binary: That text is a binary ID; it is not edited by hand.
msg.json_type_int: This value is a whole number.
msg.json_type_text: This value is a text of up to {max} characters, without line breaks.
msg.json_same: The value is the same; nothing to change.
msg.json_one_file: Only {file} changes; the slot's other file stays as it is.
msg.json_expert_risk: Manual change: Olympian checks the file stays intact, but cannot know whether the game accepts the new value.
err.edit_verify: Verifying the change failed; nothing was changed.
err.edit_verify_outside: Verifying the change failed; nothing was changed.
err.edit_overlap: Internal error: two changes overlap; nothing was changed.
grid.damaged: Damaged or unfinished: fix it in the game or with "Repair"
msg.inv_delete_corvette: {item} is corvette technology: it comes from its parts and is changed in the game, in the corvette editor.
msg.ship_repair_nothing: This ship has no damaged modules.
msg.ship_unlock_what: {file}: ship {n} ({name}) — {opened} cells opened or repaired (damaged cells are left free, without the damaged component, as when repaired in the game).
msg.ship_unlock_nothing: This ship has no closed cells.
msg.inv_repair_what: {item} in {inv} (cell {at}) is repaired: no damage and fully installed, as after the game's repair. No materials are spent.
mis.stage_tip: Point of the stage tree where the save left this mission. A finished mission may stay at any stage (where its branch ended), so this number is not progress towards the end.
mis.same_title: {n} different game missions with this title
mis.copy_tip: The same mission appears more than once in your save.
err.locked: Olympian is locked: type your PIN and the code from your authenticator app.
err.lock_wait: Too many attempts. Wait 30 seconds and try again.
err.lock_bad_code: The code is not correct or it expired. Type the one your authenticator app shows now.
err.lock_bad_recovery: That recovery code is not valid or was already used.
err.lock_pin_format: The PIN must have 4 to 12 digits.
err.lock_already: Protection is already on. Turn it off first to set it up again.
err.lock_reset_needed: You came in with a recovery code: set up protection again (or turn it off) in Settings before destructive changes.
err.extra_invalid: That folder does not exist. Create it first or pick another one.
err.extra_inside: Pick a folder outside the save folder: the point is that the copy survives even if that folder is deleted.
err.backup_failed: The backup could not be completed; nothing was deleted.
lock.title: Olympian is protected
lock.help: Type your PIN and the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows.
lock.recover_help: Type one of your recovery codes. Each code works once; afterwards you will need to set up protection again.
lock.use_recovery: Lost the PIN or the phone: use a recovery code
lock.code_again: This action is not easy to undo: type the current code from your authenticator app.
lock.off_help: Optional. Opening Olympian will ask for a PIN and the 6-digit code of an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…). Destructive actions (deleting saves or ships, copying or restoring over an occupied slot, purging backups) ask for the code again. Works offline and without an account.
lock.limits: It stops people from using Olympian on this PC; it does not stop anyone from touching the saves in File Explorer. Lock Windows (Win+L) when you step away and use the backup copy outside the folder.
lock.recovered_note: You came in with a recovery code. Set up protection again (or turn it off) to keep using destructive actions.
lock.disable_help: To turn it off, type your PIN and the current code.
lock.setup_help: Choose a PIN of 4 to 12 digits. Do not store it on this PC.
lock.scan_help: Open your authenticator app, tap “Add” and scan this QR code.
lock.key_help: Cannot scan? Type this key in the app (type: time based):
lock.recovery_help: Keep them somewhere safe, away from this PC (on paper, for example). Each one works once if you lose the PIN or the phone. They will not be shown again.
start.delete_needs_lock: To delete saves, turn on PIN and code protection in Settings, or tick “I live alone” there.
msg.slot_empty_delete: Slot {slot} is empty: there is nothing to delete.
msg.delete_slot_backup: A full backup of the slot is made first; you can restore it from Start. accountdata.hg is not touched.
msg.delete_slot_cloud: If you use Steam Cloud or Hello Games cross-save, the cloud may download this save again when the game starts.
bk.purge_tip: Deletes old automatic backups and always keeps the newest {keep}. The ones you made are not touched.
bk.purge_help: {n} old automatic backups are deleted and {size} is freed.
bk.purge_safe: The newest {keep} automatic backups and every backup you made are always kept.
bk.extra_title: Backup copy outside the save folder
bk.extra_help: Optional. Every backup is also copied to this folder (another drive, a USB stick, OneDrive…), so it survives even if the save folder is deleted. Start lists the ones in both places.
bk.extra_ok: Extra folder saved: the next backups are copied there.
bk.extra_removed: Backups are no longer copied to the extra folder.
ov.rep_note: Standing points the save keeps; the game turns them into ranks.
ov.links_note: Tap an item with › to open its view. The multi-tool has no view of its own yet.
lot.title: Settlement lots
lot.legend: {n} buildings · {up} in progress (⚙) · {rdy} ready to complete (✔) · {known} with a known type. Olympian learns each lot type when the game names it; the rest are shown generic with their class. States deduced from real saves; read only.
ship.seed_from: Copy from another ship of yours…
ship.seed_from_tip: Only ships of the same model: a seed of another ship type would give a broken ship.
ship.seed_note: Changes only the looks (shape and colours). Class, cells, technology and stats stay. A seed from an external list may not look like its picture if the game changed; a backup lets you go back.
msg.ship_recharge_nothing: This ship has no partly charged technology.
msg.needs_protection: To delete saves or copy a save over another, turn on PIN and code protection in Settings, or tick “I live alone” there.
lock.alone: I live alone: allow deleting and copying over another save without PIN or code
lock.alone_help: For people who do not share the PC. The backup first, the preview and the check that the game is closed stay.
lock.alone_confirm: Anyone using this PC will be able to delete saves or copy one over another from Olympian without PIN or code.
lock.alone_safe: A full backup you can restore from Start is made before each one.
lock.alone_on: Done: deleting and copying over no longer ask for protection.
lock.alone_off: Deleting and copying over ask for protection again.
lock.offer_title: Protect Olympian with PIN and code (optional)
lock.offer_help: Olympian can ask for a PIN and the 6-digit code of an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…) when it opens, and again before actions that delete or overwrite a save. It works offline and without an account.
lock.offer_disabled: Without protection, these features are disabled:
lock.offer_d2: Copying a save over another that already exists (copying to an empty slot is allowed).
lock.offer_alone: If you live alone and do not need it, choose “I live alone”: those features stay available without PIN or code, always with a backup first.
lock.offer_after: You can turn protection, and the “I live alone” option, on or off at any time in Settings.
ov.race_note: The one you chose at the Appearance Modifier
ov.no_view_yet: No view of its own yet
ov.unavailable: The summary of this save could not be read.
ship.transfer: Copy or move to another save
ship.transfer_none: There are no other saves to copy to.
msg.ship_transfer_what: Slot {slot} ({file}): ship {n} “{name}” is copied into ship slot {to}.
msg.ship_transfer_loot: Everything goes with it: technology, cargo, cells, class and looks, byte for byte.
msg.ship_transfer_corvette: Corvettes are not copied to other saves: they are built from parts kept apart from the ship.
msg.ship_transfer_custom: This ship has a custom look kept apart (built ships); it is not copied so it is not left broken.
msg.ship_transfer_no_dest: Pick at least one destination save other than this one.
msg.ship_transfer_format: Slot {slot} has another save format; it is not copied.
msg.ship_transfer_full: Slot {slot} ({file}) has no free ship slots.
msg.ship_transfer_save_first: Save or discard the pending changes of this save first.
msg.ship_move_remove: After copying, ship {n} “{name}” is removed from slot {slot}.
action.ship_transfer: before copying a ship to another save
editor.home_tip: Start screen: pick a save, backups, copy, restore and delete saves
lot.ready: upgrade to {to} ready: complete it in the game
lot.timer_done: upgrade to {to}: the timer has run out, ready to apply in the game
lot.stage_done: this stage's timer has run out: ready to continue in the game
msg.inv_manual_only: The autosave ({auto}) and your manual save ({file}) hold that inventory differently: only {file} is changed, the one you saved yourself (leaving the ship or at a save point). {auto} stays as it was.
msg.save_manual_only: The autosave ({auto}) and your manual save ({file}) disagree here: only {file} is changed, the one you saved yourself (leaving the ship or at a save point). {auto} stays as it was.
ship.expand_note_both: cargo to 120 cells and technology to 60. The 4 supercharged cells are already in the save and stay where they are.
tip.ranges: Possible improvements (game range; the exact value depends on each module):
about.title: About
about.lines:
To my dear wife and my beloved family, for letting me keep being a kid even as an adult.
Pangro Daer Barun D'Gross, for continuing to corrupt me with video games.
Fenrir, because even though he hardly plays anymore, he's still up for talking about my adventures and misadventures.
autosort.title: Auto-sort technology
autosort.ask: What do you prioritise in the supercharged slots? Choose one or two.
autosort.note: The rest of the technology is arranged to gain adjacency. It can take a few seconds (with Damage a bit longer: it tries each weapon).
autosort.recommend: The weapon that performs best with your modules is {w}: it goes in the supercharged slots.
autosort.v.dps: {w}: approx. damage per second (damage × fire rate)
autosort.moves: {n} modules will move inside the technology grid.
autosort.how: Values calculated with the game's rules (supercharged slots, adjacency and the ship's class). Check the ones that go down before applying.
autosort.already: The technology is already in the best arrangement found for those priorities.
tip.values: Values of this module (as the game shows them: with supercharge, without adjacency):
real.title: Real ship values
real.note: Calculated like the game: base + modules + upgrades + adjacency + supercharged slots + ship class. They are the ones the ship screen shows. Damage Potential and Manoeuvrability use this ship's seed; the game uses the primary ship's, so they match the screen when this ship is the primary one.
bonus.note: Sum of the installed upgrades, with adjacency and supercharged slots, without the ship's class bonus.
lot.next_stage: next stage ready to start in the game (▶)
lock.alone_card: I live alone: editing without a safety net
lock.alone_loses: While this is on, anyone using this PC can delete saves and copy a save over another one without a PIN or code.
lock.alone_badge_tip: "I live alone" is on: deleting saves and copying over don't ask for a PIN or code. Change it in Settings.
imp.title: Imported saves (other players')
imp.help: A separate space for other people's saves: they never mix with yours or your slots. Use it to help someone edit their save and send it back, or just to look at their data. Accepts Steam saves (a folder or .zip with the save*.hg and mf_save*.hg files) and Xbox / PC Game Pass saves (the wgs folder).
imp.add_help: Paste the path of the folder (or .zip) you were sent. Steam: the st_… folder or one with the save*.hg and mf_save*.hg files. Xbox / Game Pass: the whole wgs folder.
imp.found_steam: Steam save: {n} slot(s) found. Pick which one to import.
imp.found_xbox: Xbox / Game Pass save: {n} slot(s) found. Pick which one to import.
imp.label: A name to recognise it (for example, whose it is)
imp.note: A separate copy is kept in Olympian's folder. The original folder is not touched and bases do not change owner: the save still belongs to its owner.
imp.done: Save imported. It is under "Imported saves".
imp.none: You have not imported any save yet.
imp.remove_q: "{name}" is removed from the imported space (only Olympian's copy; the original folder is not touched). An export you already made is not touched either.
imp.export_help: Writes the save to a new folder, ready to send to its owner, with a file explaining how to install it.
imp.export_slot: Slot its owner will install it in
imp.export_dest: Folder where the export is created
imp.export_note: A new subfolder is created; your own save folder is never written to.
imp.exported_send: Zip that folder and send it to its owner. Inside there is a file with the steps to install it.
err.import_missing: That folder or file does not exist.
err.import_kind: No No Man's Sky save (Steam or Xbox) was found there.
err.import_too_big: The .zip is too big to be a save.
err.import_verify: The copy failed verification; nothing was imported.
err.import_unknown: That imported save no longer exists.
err.import_open: That save is open. Go back to the start screen before removing it.
err.import_readonly: This imported save is view only. Switch it to "Allow changes" on the start screen to edit it.
err.import_own_only: With an imported save open you cannot copy, restore, delete or move ships to your own saves: that way they never mix.
err.export_dest: The destination folder does not exist.
err.export_own_folder: Pick a folder outside your save folder.
imp.xbox_help: Writes the save back into the Game Pass folder you imported it from, the way the game saves. It copies that whole folder first.
imp.xbox_reimport: To write it back to Xbox, import it again from the «wgs» folder (not a .zip): that way Olympian knows where to write and whether the game saved over it afterwards.
imp.xbox_only: Only for saves imported from Xbox / Game Pass.
imp.xbox_title: Write back to Xbox / Game Pass
imp.xbox_game_unknown: Couldn't check whether the game is running: close it before continuing.
imp.xbox_steps: The game and the Xbox app must be closed. If that folder is a copy, put it back into the game folder on its owner's PC afterwards (backing it up first). When the game starts online, the Xbox cloud takes the new version (tested on Nov 23).
imp.xbox_done: Done: the save was written into {folder} and read back with no differences.
imp.xbox_backup: Copy of the folder before writing: {folder}
imp.xbox_after: Start the game online, load the save and save once inside it.
err.xbox_not_xbox: This save didn't come from Xbox / Game Pass.
err.xbox_reimport: It's not known which folder to write it back to: import it again from the «wgs» folder.
err.xbox_missing: The Game Pass folder it was imported from is gone (or has no containers.index).
err.xbox_changed: The game saved to that slot after the import: writing over it would erase that progress. Import it again.
err.xbox_no_container: That slot is missing one of its two saves in the Game Pass folder; Olympian doesn't create new saves there.
err.xbox_verify: Reading the Game Pass folder back didn't match. Restore the copy made before writing (it's in the imported save's folder, _xbox_backups).
travel.visited: You have been to this galaxy (discoveries, bases or portals there)
jr.title: Medals and milestones
jr.note: Like the game's journey page: the level reached in each stat, from the game's own table of levels. Read only.
lot.class_after: Class when construction is finished: C
bonus.none: No installed upgrade adds to this value.
real.hint: Hover over each value to see what its upgrades add up to.
inv.sort_shield_note: In a ship's cargo, whatever recharges the shield (sodium, sodium nitrate, Starshield Battery, or what that ship's shield uses) always goes first, whatever the order you pick, so you find it fast in a surprise attack. This notice is shown only once.
msg.inv_gather_item_what: {inv}: {units} units of {item} arrive from all the other inventories ({n} stacks emptied at their source).
msg.inv_gather_item_none: There is no {item} in the other inventories.
msg.inv_gather_item_full: There is no room in {inv} for more {item}.
msg.ship_corvette_delete_what: {file}: corvette {n} ({name}) is removed with its inventory and its build base ({parts} placed parts), as when you dispose of it in the game. Its slot becomes free.
msg.ship_corvette_delete_parts: The parts fitted to it are lost, as in the game. To keep any, remove them first in the game's corvette editor and save.
msg.ship_in_use_corvette_bases: Corvette {n} ({name}) is linked to more than one base; it cannot be deleted without reviewing the save.
inv.delsel_hint: Deletes the selected items (in one or more inventories). You confirm in the preview first.
ships.sel_hint: Click items of the open ship to select them.
ship.bad_tech: This ship has {n} technologies its type does not accept: {items}.
msg.ship_copy_swapped: {count} technologies are swapped for their equivalent on this type of ship: {pairs}.
msg.ship_copy_left: {count} technologies are not copied because this type of ship does not accept them and they have no equivalent: {ids}.
msg.ship_fix_tech_none: Ship {n} ({name}) has no technology its type does not accept.
msg.ship_fix_tech_what: {file}: ship {n} ({name}) has {count} technologies its type does not accept; they are corrected the way the game would need.
msg.ship_fix_tech_removed: {count} are taken out because the ship already has their equivalent or there is none: {ids}.
msg.inv_delmany_none: Nothing in the selection can be deleted (core technology and corvette technology stay).
msg.inv_delmany_what: {count} selected items are deleted from: {invs}. They cannot be recovered except by discarding or restoring a backup.
msg.inv_delmany_kept: {count} stay where they are because the game does not let you dismantle them either: {ids}.
